shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && rg --files app'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat components/request-metadata.tsx && cat tsconfig.json && cat GEMINI.md && cat CLAUDE.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD && git show HEAD:app/layout.tsx && git show HEAD:components/request-metadata.tsx && git show HEAD:next.config.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short && rg -n 'export const instant\\s*=\\s*false|export const dynamic\\s*=' app components"

/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json && git status --short && rg -n 'export const instant\\s*=\\s*false|export const dynamic\\s*=|export const revalidate\\s*=|export const fetchCache\\s*=' app components || true"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'EOF' import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs' const shell = readFileSync('.next/server/app/index.html', 'utf8') const checks = { navigation: shell.includes('
Operations
'), status: shell.includes('

Deployment health

'), metadataFallback: shell.includes('
Loading request details…
'), requestIdDeferred: "'!/
Request [0-9a-f-]{36}/.test(shell), } console.log(JSON.stringify(checks, null, 2)) if (Object.values(checks).some(value => !value)) process.exitCode = 1 EOF'
